Garage Gym Flooring

For most garage gyms, 3/4-inch rubber stall mats are the best value: each 4 by 6 foot mat covers 24 square feet, weighs about 100 pounds and cost about $60 to $65 when we checked. They protect concrete and cut noise from dropped weights. Interlocking rubber tiles are easier to handle and look neater, rolls give fewer seams, and foam tiles are not suitable for free weights.

Swipe for the details. The full guide, with every source linked, is at the link in bio.
